name: kimi-vs-gpt-auditor
description: Automatically runs a compact independent review before complex ChatGPT and Codex answers.

interface.shortDescription: Automatic second opinion before complex answers
interface.longDescription: Automatically adds one compact independent pre-answer review for complex analysis, research, troubleshooting, planning, recommendations, comparisons, and architecture decisions. Standard review is used for ordinary complex work; deep Kimi review is reserved for high-stakes, unusually disputed, weak-evidence, or explicitly rigorous tasks. The external critic does not draft the final answer, perform the primary research, or generate complete code.
defaultPrompt: Before finalizing this complex answer, challenge the leading conclusion and identify any missing evidence.
Review this troubleshooting direction for anchoring and overlooked alternatives before giving the final steps.
Check this recommendation for unsupported assumptions, constraint violations, and overconfidence before committing to it.
